recalled_knowledge.item: Poisson-Gamma predictive = negative binomial; Gamma(alpha,1) rate with exposure k gives P(n) = C(n+alpha-1,n) (1/(1+k))^alpha (k/(1+k))^n
log-uniform prior on a Poisson rate updated by one event gives an Exponential(1) posterior (mean 1 = MLE); flat prior gives Gamma(2,1) (mean 2); Jeffreys gives Gamma(1.5,1)
1 April 2024 is day 92 of the (leap) year; 27 March 2023 is day 86; 27 March 2023 - 1 April 2024 spans 371 calendar days
Bayes factor and posterior-odds algebra for a three-hypothesis mixture
